tags.name: current-state
tags.description: Read the current state of all main signs

get.summary: Get the current state of all main signs as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection
get.description: Returns every main sign currently stored, including everything George derived while processing it. The result can be restricted to a bounding box and to the filters below. Filters are combined with AND, values within a single filter with OR.

parameters.name: Accept-Crs
parameters.description: Coordinate reference system the response geometry should be expressed in. Defaults to WGS84 when omitted.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box to restrict the result to, as `minX,minY,maxX,maxY` in the coordinate reference system given by `bbox-crs`. A six value form `minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ` is accepted as well, the elevation values are ignored.

parameters.name: bbox-crs
parameters.description: Coordinate reference system the `bbox` parameter is expressed in.

parameters.name: crs
parameters.description: Coordinate reference system the response geometry should be expressed in. Takes precedence over the `Accept-Crs` header.

parameters.name: countyCode
parameters.description: Restrict the result to signs on roads managed by this county. Must start with GM followed by the county number in four digits.

parameters.name: rvvCode
parameters.description: Restrict the result to signs with one of these RVV codes.

parameters.name: roadSectionId
parameters.description: Restrict the result to signs matched to one of these NWB road sections.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Restrict the result to signs with this status. Defaults to `PLACED`.

parameters.name: roadAuthorityType
parameters.description: Restrict the result to signs owned by a road authority of this type.

parameters.name: roadAuthorityCode
parameters.description: Restrict the result to signs owned by the road authority with this code.

parameters.name: obCode
parameters.description: Restrict the result to signs that carry a supplementary sign with one of these codes.

200.description: The current state of all main signs, or the subset matching the requested filters.

ConditionPropertiesV5.description: A set of conditions under which a restriction or exemption applies.

vehicleType.description: Vehicle types this condition applies to.

category.description: Traffic categories this condition applies to.

timeValidity.description: Time window for these conditions in OSM format.

emissionClass.description: Not yet used, will be used later when emission zone signs are mapped.

fuelType.description: Not yet used, will be used later when emission zone signs are mapped.

axleWeight.description: Max value as filled in by the user in the black code of the traffic sign.

height.description: Max value as filled in by the user in the black code of the traffic sign.

length.description: Max value as filled in by the user in the black code of the traffic sign.

weight.description: Max value as filled in by the user in the black code of the traffic sign.

width.description: Max value as filled in by the user in the black code of the traffic sign.

restrictions.description: Always present, may be an empty object if there are no restrictions. Contains what is forbidden by this sign.

exemptions.description: Always present, may be an empty array. What is allowed despite the restriction.

ExternalReferenceV5.description: Reference to this object in an external system.

id.description: Identifier of the object in the external system.

FeatureV5.description: A GeoJSON Feature Object representing a main sign as it is currently stored, including everything George derived while processing it.

id.description: Always present. Unique identifier of the traffic sign.

Geometry.description: Location of the main sign as a GeoJSON Point.

coordinates.description: Position of the sign, interpreted in the coordinate reference system given by the `Content-Crs` header: `[longitude, latitude]` for WGS84, `[x, y]` for RD.

MainSignFeatureCollectionV5.description: A GeoJSON FeatureCollection of every main sign currently stored.

features.description: Always present, empty when there is nothing to report.

MainSignV5.description: Properties of a main sign as it is currently stored, including everything George derived while processing it.

rvvCode.description: Always present. The RVV code of this sign.

blackCode.description: The value displayed on the sign, for example the speed limit on an A1.

zoneCode.description: Whether this sign marks the begin, repeat or end of a zone. `UNKNOWN` only occurs on older signs.

supplementarySigns.description: Always present, empty when there is nothing to report. Supplementary text signs attached to this sign.

externalReferences.description: Always present, empty when there is nothing to report. External system references for this sign.

placement.description: Whether the sign is placed above or alongside the road.

bearing.description: Orientation of the sign in degrees.

roadSectionId.description: Identifier of the NWB road section this sign was matched to.

countyCode.description: Present when the sign was matched to a road section. Code of the county containing the road this traffic sign is on

countyName.description: Present when the sign was matched to a road section. Name of the county containing the road this traffic sign is on

nwbVersion.description: Version of the NWB the road section refers to.

privateProperty.description: Always present. Whether this sign is located on private property.

missingRoadSection.description: Always present. Whether this sign is on a road that is not yet present in NWB.

fraction.description: Present when the sign was matched to a road section. Relative position of the sign along the road section, between 0 and 1.

drivingDirection.description: Present when the sign was matched to a road section, and the direction could be determined based on the bearing and fraction. Driving direction of the road section this sign applies to.

registeredOn.description: Date this sign was first registered.

lastModifiedOn.description: Date this sign was last modified.

removedOn.description: Date this sign was removed. Absent as long as the sign is in place.

placedOn.description: Date this sign was physically placed.

expectedPlacedOn.description: Date this sign is expected to be placed.

expectedRemovedOn.description: Date this sign is expected to be removed.

validatedOn.description: Date this sign was last validated. Absent when it has never been validated.

trafficOrderId.description: Reference to the published traffic order (verkeersbesluit) this sign is based on.

ownerType.description: Present when the sign has an owner. Type of the road authority that owns this sign.

ownerCode.description: Present when the sign has an owner. Code of the road authority that owns this sign.

SupplementarySignV5.description: A supplementary sign attached to a main sign, as George stores it.

text.description: Free text shown on the supplementary sign.

openingHours.description: If applicable for the obCode, the time window in OSM format.

index.description: Always present. Position of this supplementary sign relative to the other supplementary signs.  Supplementary signs that are combined in a group have the same index.

externalReferences.description: Always present, empty when there is nothing to report. External system references for this supplementary sign.
